Vistulo | Fully REMOTE (Poland or Romanian residents only) | B2B contract | US Eastern timezone overlap required

Vistulo is a boutique outsourcing company based in Poland. We specialize in expert-level talent for financial institutions. All roles are for work with a top North American banking client.

All roles are 100% remote, B2B contract, rates are net + VAT in PLN, long-term.

Senior Java Trading Systems Engineer — 270–300 zł/hr — equities & FX, algo order management and routing, low-latency core Java — https://ats.vistulo.com/roles/253cbd69-1019-4547-93b6-6ef8db...

Senior React Frontend Developer (Fixed Income) — 220–250 zł/hr — React/TypeScript/OpenFin desktop trading apps — https://ats.vistulo.com/roles/1f5cb00f-791b-4491-a189-32a272...

Java Backend Engineer — 220–240 zł/hr — high-throughput trading backend, event-driven distributed systems, 6+ yrs — https://ats.vistulo.com/roles/64866447-8224-49ab-b655-5c2f89...

Business Analyst / Product Owner — Murex — 200–240 zł/hr — Murex config, integration or MXtest; FX, payments, SWIFT — https://ats.vistulo.com/roles/49e20bfe-7453-4ffa-bfe8-8b2799...

All open roles: https://ats.vistulo.com/roles/hn/
